The rigged GLB includes walk/run clips and passes the validator with zero errors after the recorded skin-weight normalization. Strong non-cartoon human anchor for the library.

decisions.notes: Technically clean rigged teenager, but the face and hair are clearly anime/stylized: large eyes, smooth simplified features and sculpted hair clumps. The user specifically asked for realistic, non-cartoonish humans, so this does not fit the realistic-human category even though the clothing and geometry are complete. It could be reconsidered later under a stylized category, not as a realistic human anchor.
limitations: Rejected for style mismatch, not license or format failure.
Stylized/anime facial proportions are visible in front and three-quarter views.
